exercises.instructionEn: MODULE 2 - The Way We Are. Read, listen, talk and write about... Unit 5: Planning Ahead.  Unit 6: Food, Glorious Food.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-MODUL - Biz qandaymiz. O'qing, tinglang, gapiring va yozing... 5-unit: Oldindan reja tuzish.  6-unit: Ovqat, ajoyib ovqat.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - 2-MODUL MUQOVASINING ChAP
BETI.

  Modul muqovasi IKKI BETLIK YOYMA:
     chap bet (bu) - 5 va 6-unitlar
     o'ng bet - 7 va 8-unitlar va
        modul rejasi

  ⚠ Bet raqami bosilmagan.


MODUL NOMI:

  'The Way We Are' = Biz qandaymiz

  ⚠ 'the way' bu yerda 'usul' emas,
  'tarz, qanday' ma'nosida:
     'the way we are' = biz qanday
        odammiz
     'the way you speak' = qanday
        gapirishing

  ⚠ Bu - juda ko'p ishlatiladigan
  qolip: 'I like the way you think.'

  ⚠ DIQQAT: bu nom MUNDARIJADA YO'Q -
  u faqat modul muqovasida bor.


UNIT 5 - 'Planning Ahead'

  = Oldindan reja tuzish

  ⚠ 'to plan ahead' = oldindan
  rejalashtirmoq.
  ⚠ 'ahead' = oldinda, oldinga.
  ⚠ 'plan' - qisqa unli + bitta undosh:
  'planNING' (undosh IKKILANADI).

  Mavzular:
     • job qualities = kasb uchun kerakli
       xislatlar
     • plans = rejalar
     • holidays = ta'til

  SURATLAR:
     1) RAFTING - shov-shuvli daryoda
        rezina qayiqda eshkak eshish.
        ⚠ Bu - xavfli sport, jasorat
        talab qiladi.

     2) HIMOYa KOSTYUMIDAGI odam -
        kimyoviy xavf bilan ishlaydigan
        mutaxassis.
        ⚠ Ikki surat ham XAVFLI KASB
        haqida - unit kasb xislatlari
        haqida.


UNIT 6 - 'Food, Glorious Food'

  = Ovqat, ajoyib ovqat

  ⚠ 'glorious' = ajoyib, shonli.
  ⚠ Bu - 'Oliver!' myuziklidagi
  mashhur qo'shiq nomi (1960).

  Mavzular:
     • food = ovqat
     • drinks = ichimliklar
     • service at restaurants =
       restoranda xizmat
     • containers = idishlar

  SURATLAR:
     1) TEZ OVQAT - gamburger va
        kartoshka fri.
     2) RESTORAN - ofitsiant sharob
        quymoqda.

  ⚠ Ikki surat ikki xil ovqatlanish
  madaniyatini ko'rsatadi: tez ovqat
  va restoran.


⚠ 'A CONTAINER':

  = idish, quti.
  ⚠ 'to contain' = ichida saqlamoq.
  ⚠ 6-unitda 'a packet of', 'a jar of',
  'a tin of' kabi iboralar o'rganiladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  the way       = tarz, qanday
  to plan ahead = oldindan reja tuzmoq
  ahead         = oldinda
  a quality     = xislat, sifat
  a plan        = reja
  glorious      = ajoyib, shonli
  a container   = idish
  service       = xizmat
  a raft        = rezina qayiq
  a life jacket = qutqaruv jileti
  a protective suit = himoya kostyumi

exercises.instructionEn: Module 2 - Units 5-8. Learn how to ... Practise ... Unit 7: Profiles.  Unit 8: A Brush with Danger.
exercises.instructionUz: 2-modul - 5-8-unitlar. Qanday qilishni o'rganing... Mashq qiling... 7-unit: Shaxsiy tavsiflar.  8-unit: Xavf bilan yuzma-yuz.
exercises.explanationUz:
BU BET - 2-MODUL MUQOVASINING O'NG
BETI: MODUL REJASI.


REJA IKKI QISMDAN:

  1) 'LEARN HOW TO ...' - NUTQ
     VAZIFALARI
  2) 'PRACTISE ...' - GRAMMATIKA


'LEARN HOW TO' RO'YXATI:

  make appointments
     = uchrashuv belgilamoq
     ⚠ 'an appointment' = belgilangan
     uchrashuv (shifokor, tirgashuvchi).
     ⚠ 'to MAKE an appointment' -
     'to do' EMAS.

  remind & reassure people
     = eslatmoq va tinchlantirmoq
     ⚠ 'to remind sb ABOUT/OF sth'
     ⚠ 'to reassure' = tinchlantirmoq,
     ishontirmoq ('re-' + 'assure').

  make polite requests & offers
     = xushmuomala iltimos va takliflar
     ⚠ 1-modulda ham bor edi (8-bet) -
     bu yerda YaNADA rivojlantiriladi.

  accept & refuse
     = qabul qilmoq va rad etmoq
     ⚠ 5-betdagi kirishda ham bu ikki
     so'z misol sifatida berilgan edi.

  ask for & give permission
     = ruxsat so'ramoq va bermoq
     ⚠ 'to ask FOR permission' -
     predlog 'for'.
     ⚠ 'permission' - SANALMAYDIGAN.

  apologise
     = uzr so'ramoq
     ⚠ Britaniyada '-ise', AQShda '-ize'.
     ⚠ 'to apologise TO sb FOR sth'.


'PRACTISE' RO'YXATI:

  will / going to / present continuous
     = kelasi zamonning uch shakli
     ⚠ 25-betdagi 'Will' qutisida
     boshlangan edi.

  conditionals types 0/1
     = shart gaplarining 0 va 1-turi
     ⚠ 0-tur: umumiy haqiqat
        'If you heat ice, it melts.'
     ⚠ 1-tur: real kelajak
        'If it rains, I'll stay at home.'

  a/an/some/any
     = artikl va noaniq miqdor
     ⚠ 18-betdagi 3-mashqda 'any'
     boshlangan edi.

  much/many - a few/a little
     = miqdor so'zlari
     ⚠ 'much' + sanalmaydigan;
     'many' + sanaladigan.
     ⚠ 'a few' + sanaladigan;
     'a little' + sanalmaydigan.

  should (advice)
     = maslahat berish
     ⚠ 9-betdagi xatda ham bor edi:
     'I think you SHOULD come here.'

  present perfect simple/continuous
     = hozirgi tugallangan zamon
     ⚠ 16-betdagi matnda uchragan edi:
     'Liza's lifestyle HAS CHANGED'.

  past perfect simple vs past simple
     = o'tgan tugallangan zamon va
       oddiy o'tgan zamon farqi


UNIT 7 - 'Profiles'

  = Shaxsiy tavsiflar

  ⚠ 'a profile' = odam haqidagi qisqa
  tavsif (matbuotda).
  ⚠ Yana: yon tomondan ko'rinish;
  ijtimoiy tarmoqdagi sahifa.

  Mavzular:
     • health = sog'liq
     • illness = kasallik
     • accidents = baxtsiz hodisalar
     • changes in lifestyle = turmush
       tarzidagi o'zgarishlar

  SURATLAR:
     1) ShIFOKOR quloqni tekshirmoqda.
     2) KITOB O'QIYaPGAN erkak -
        3-betdagi mundarijaga ko'ra bu
        BILL GEYTS haqidagi matnga
        ishora.


UNIT 8 - 'A Brush with Danger'

  = Xavf bilan yuzma-yuz

  ⚠ 'a brush with sth' - IBORA:
  biror narsa bilan qisqa, xavfli
  to'qnashuv.
  ⚠ 'a brush' odatda = cho'tka, mo'yqalam -
  bu yerda BUTUNLAY boshqa ma'no.
  ⚠ SO'ZMA-SO'Z tarjima qilmang!

  Mavzular:
     • experiences = tajribalar
     • preparations = tayyorgarlik
     • feelings = his-tuyg'ular

  SURAT: ULKAN KALMAR qayiqdagi
  baliqchiga hujum qilmoqda.
     ⚠ 'a squid' = kalmar.
     ⚠ 'a tentacle' = paypaslagich.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an appointment = belgilangan uchrashuv
  to remind      = eslatmoq
  to reassure    = tinchlantirmoq
  to accept      = qabul qilmoq
  to refuse      = rad etmoq
  permission     = ruxsat
  to apologise   = uzr so'ramoq
  a conditional  = shart gapi
  advice         = maslahat
  a profile      = shaxsiy tavsif
  health         = sog'liq
  illness        = kasallik
  an accident    = baxtsiz hodisa
  an experience  = tajriba
  a preparation  = tayyorgarlik
  a brush with   = ... bilan yuzma-yuz kelish

sentencePatterns.formula: In this module we read and talk about [mavzu].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In this module we read and talk about job qualities and plans.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu modulda kasb xislatlari va rejalar haqida o'qiymiz va gapiramiz.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I like the way you think.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'the way' = tarz, qanday.
⚠ Modul nomi ham shu qolipdan:
'The Way We Are'.

sentencePatterns.formula: It is important to plan ahead.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It is important to plan ahead before a holiday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ta'tildan oldin oldindan reja tuzish muhim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to plan ahead' = oldindan rejalashtirmoq.
⚠ 'planNING' - undosh IKKILANADI.

sentencePatterns.formula: In this module I learn how to [nima qilish].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: In this module I learn how to make appointments.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'learn how to' + INFINITIV.
⚠ 'to MAKE an appointment' - 'to do' EMAS.

sentencePatterns.formula: I would like to ask for permission to [fe'l].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would like to ask for permission to leave early.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Erta ketish uchun ruxsat so'ramoqchi edim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to ask FOR permission' - predlog 'for'.
⚠ 'permission' - SANALMAYDIGAN ot.

sentencePatterns.formula: I would like to apologise for [nima].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I would like to apologise for being late.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'to apologise FOR' + -ING.
⚠ 'to apologise TO sb FOR sth'.
